first_review_findings.reason: The proposed audit_logs row and decision TraceID linkage partially define persistence, but omit the required schema version, scope, effect index, and queued status. The single-row Args value only stores bytes. Unique/cardinality and trace-collision behavior remain underspecified.

The fingerprint hash vector is reproducible, but active codec field types, array element types, and an explicit golden codec JSON fixture are absent; field names alone cannot define strict codec tests.

The revised harness verifies committed receipt/checkpoint/audit/two outbox rows via an independent connection after COMMIT and before dropping the HTTP response, establishing the required ordering. Implementation must preserve the one-shot, non-request-configurable hook.

No deterministic held-writer/lookup, receipt lookup unavailable, or post-settlement same-ID re-entry tests are added. The new E2E covers a known committed receipt, not pending_unknown; pre-COMMIT interruption does not prove rollback evidence.
The dual-pool test has no synchronization barrier proving overlap; its row-sequence cardinality and identical receipt equality remain ambiguous, allowing sequential execution to pass.
Required outcome/reason enums and event sequences are not listed, and serialized-log privacy assertions lack a concrete forbidden-value matrix.

disposition: Not approved yet; resolve the five blocked findings and request a fresh cross-domain design review.
